_note: UNTESTED community images for the Newsheen. Each is served same-origin from firmware/ and pinned to a sha256 the flasher verifies. A hard untested-gate is shown before every flash.

images.name: Transcript-Sheen
images.author: Retia LLC
images.desc: Turns the lamp into a private meeting transcriber. Hold the button for 2s to go on air (slow red pulse); the lamp streams its microphone — encrypted with ChaCha20-Poly1305 — to a Raspberry Pi on your network that runs local speech-to-text and shows a live transcript you can open from anywhere. Works across different networks with no port forwarding: both sides dial out to a free public MQTT broker, which only ever relays ciphertext. Runs on top of normal WLED. Set your encryption key + topic in Usermod Settings after flashing (no secret is baked in). Requires an I2S MEMS microphone (INMP441 or SPH0645) wired to the J3 header. Full guide: github.com/skickar/transcript-sheen.

images.name: Newsheen RGBtastic
images.author: sasquelch-digital
images.desc: A Meshtastic fork that adds RGB light effects and remote control — the 8 LEDs react to mesh activity, and you can drive them remotely over the mesh. Needs the optional LoRa radio (Wio-SX1262) fitted; attach a 915 MHz antenna before transmitting.
